premises.text: Students struggle to find qualified, accessible, available private tutors quickly, especially for after-school tutoring in the Middle East
premises.evidence_span: One out of three students struggle to find a tutor

premises.text: A peer-to-peer app connects students to pre-vetted tutors in three steps: pick course, select tutor, book session
premises.evidence_span: a peer-to-peer platform that connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps

premises.text: Built-in online tutoring includes note sharing, whiteboarding, video, chat, location sharing, and in-person or online choice
premises.evidence_span: we build our online tutoring system from scratch with note sharing, whiteboarding, and video functionalities

premises.text: ML and graph algorithms pre-select tutor candidates and recommend tutors by proximity, education, and hours tutored
premises.evidence_span: Our machine learning algorithm are helping our HR team to pre-select our candidates

premises.text: Matching emphasizes peer tutors with similar educational background and rewards tutors with pay, internships, training, and bonuses
premises.evidence_span: we match students with peer tutors who have been in their shoes and have the same educational background

premises.text: Product is localized for the MENA market in Arabic
premises.evidence_span: Sinkers will cater for the MENA market and will be in Arabic

premises.text: Business model charges tutors 20% commission and plans institutional analytics subscriptions
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction

value.text: Making education accessible by matching students to qualified flexible private tutors
